interface.darkModeDesc: When enabled, the interface will switch to a dark theme.
interface.themeColorDesc: Click a color swatch or use the color picker to change the theme color.
interface.wallpaperDesc: Use an image behind every screen. A layer of the theme color stays on top so text remains readable.

online_search.title: Online Fetching
online_search.desc: Configure online song search, download, and associated settings.

music_client.title: Music Source Configuration
music_client.desc: Configure online music sources. Too many sources may slow down search performance.
music_client.client_limit_desc: Limit the number of songs requested per client. Too high a value may significantly reduce search speed.

online_search.fetch_timeout_desc: Maximum duration for backend to search songs. Sources that haven't completed search within this time will be stopped, returning only the already found content. Values too low may result in fewer search results.
online_search.each_song_ave_timeout_desc: Average time limit (in seconds) allocated to search each song.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.desc: Switches for related features provided by the app.
accessibility.lyricsRetryCountDesc: Retry failed or empty searches 0–10 times. Set 0 to disable. Excludes the initial search.
accessibility.searchLyricsOnlineDesc: Search public Meting first, with LRCLIB as a fallback, and cache synchronized lyrics
accessibility.showLyricsDesc: Show synchronized lyrics on the playback screen
accessibility.pinyinSearchDesc: When enabled, all searches will support fuzzy Pinyin matching.
accessibility.autoPauseOnDisconnectDesc: Automatically pause playback when headphones are unplugged or a Bluetooth device is disconnected.
accessibility.autoPlayOnConnectDesc: Auto-play when headphones or Bluetooth device are connected
accessibility.autoCleanInvalidSongsDesc: Automatically remove song entries that have been moved or deleted.
accessibility.canFetchCoverFromWebDesc: When enabled, the system will automatically go online to fetch covers for songs that lack them.
accessibility.audioFocusPauseDesc: Automatically pause playback when another app starts playing sound.
accessibility.clearCoverCacheDesc: Deletes cached cover addresses and images. Covers are looked up online again the next time they are needed.
accessibility.playQueueRepeatDesc: Wraps from the last track back to the first and from the first back to the last, looping the whole queue in both directions
